name: data-preview-table
title: Data preview table
description: A peek at tabular data: row numbers, a type chip on every column, nulls shown as nulls and a clear 'Showing 10 of 12,430 rows'.
docs: Rows are arrays in the order of `columns`, or objects keyed by column name. Pass `total` when the data has more rows than you are showing. Numbers are written exactly as they are (no rounding), and a number that arrives as text, as it does from a CSV, keeps every digit and trailing zero ("184.50"). A date without a time ("2026-11-04") stays on that day in every time zone, a day that does not exist ("2026-02-30") is shown as written, and `truncateAt` cuts only text and JSON; a cut value shows in full on hover, on focus and on a tap. Ctrl+C or Cmd+C on a focused cell copies its raw value, so a number is copied without grouping and an object as compact JSON. Giving `onColumnClick` turns the headers into buttons. `maxHeight` makes the rows scroll under a header that stays put.
